7544.title: ACP bridge discards idle user input
7544.rootCauseOneLine: Idle user chunks start agent work but unconditional noise classification discards their timeline deltas.
7544.proposedFix: Translate and coalesce external user text with existing provider-input deltas while retaining prompt, compaction, and history suppression.
7544.caveats: Bridge-boundary reproduction on Linux; original macOS/cloud setup not rerun. Specialized provenance labels and non-text input are outside this repair.
